rows.quote: These subtypes exhibited distinct risk profiles across 22 incident diseases spanning multiorgan systems in the UKBB European-ancestry cohort, with partial replication in the UKBB non-European-ancestry populations and the Taizhou Longitudinal Study in China.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the Taizhou Longitudinal Study as a replication population; the dictionary has no row for it.
Abstract describes the authors' own analyses in UK Biobank participants with participant counts only; no GWAS pipeline, release, citation or accession.
